component.name: Bloom
component.summary: Media client for Jellyfin and Silo servers; experimental native Silo support

description.p: Bloom is a media client for Jellyfin and Silo servers built for the living room. Native Silo support is experimental and capability-gated. It features a 10-foot interface designed for keyboard, gamepad, and remote control navigation, with high-quality mpv-based video playback.

ul.li: Keyboard navigation and configurable gamepad bindings; real-controller validation is pending
High-quality video playback powered by mpv
Responsive UI that adapts to any screen size and DPI
Stable Linux playback through external mpv IPC; embedded libmpv is validation-only
Series, movies, and library browsing with rich metadata

description.p: Experimental native Silo support with provider-neutral catalog and playback flows.
Development build with responsive layout system and Linux packaging support.
